role: Phase 1 Node Capability Benchmark (construction only; generation pending budget approval)
sampling: UID-hash order under seed 20260915 with disjoint salts; frozen tool-aware v1 tasks excluded; overlap between type samples allowed and reported

extraction.prompt: v1 eprompt verbatim (one call per task; both operand nodes score the same response)
extraction.quality: v1 operand recall: target operand recovered among parsed fact values (tolerance 1e-4 relative)

transformation.prompt: unit/scale conversion of a single raw value (percent/millions), frozen instruction in builder

reasoning.prompt: v1 sprompt verbatim with GOLD facts (conditional quality; no upstream contamination)
reasoning.quality: executed expression on gold facts equals reference answer (v1 tolerance)

verification.prompt: facts + candidate program + value; verdict yes/no (+ wrong operand index); gold/perturbed pairs

runner.transport_failure: kept as missing, never scored as zero

router_experiment.features: deployment-observable only: node_type one-hot, task-question GTE embedding, input context token length, node position hints; gold programs/operands never used as features
router_experiment.splits: 3 folds grouped by task_uid (no task crosses folds), seed frozen
router_experiment.utility: alpha*Q - beta*C_tokens/1000 - gamma*L_seconds/10 with v1 frozen weights
router_experiment.comparisons: paired bootstrap over tasks (10000, frozen seed); success = Node Router beats Query Router on utility with CI95 lower>0

constraints: Reasoning/verification nodes conditional on gold inputs by design

amendments.transformation: exploratory stratum: 11 natural dev nodes, no train top-up this round; main conclusions rest on extraction/reasoning/verification
amendments.r1_role: measured on every node for capability data only; frozen router candidate pool stays {medium, large, coder}; any pool expansion is a separate preregistered experiment

gates.gate1: node GAP exists: OracleNode>BestFixed on a major type, not driven by 1-2 nodes
gates.gate2: Node Router beats Query Router on quality, or matches quality at lower cost

prompt_templates.transformation:
You are verifying a unit conversion for a financial analysis. {instruction} Return ONLY JSON {{"value": number}}.
QUESTION (context only, do not re-answer it): {question}
prompt_templates.reasoning: v1 sprompt verbatim with gold facts
